title: The inn on the old road
Chart {target}
summary: {target}, the ruined inn of the old caravan road, lies {direction} of {settlement}, {distance} out. Bring back a stamp from its gate.
offer: Every caravan once stopped at {target}. If it still stands, we could open the road again. {direction}, {distance}. Bring me its gate stamp.
complete: Then the road can live again. I'll tell the caravan masters.
